Value.Value: Retrieving aria-checked attribute of identified web element to validate if all rows are selected. aria-checked attribute returns either true or false. true corresponds to all rows are selected. false corresponds to all rows are not selected.
This subflow helps to select all rows in a table.
This distinction is useful when navigating multiple tables in the UI.
